$comment: A product is written ONLY if its slug appears in approvedSlugs AND its generated
status is not BLOCKED. Structural validity of the JSON is not approval: approval
means a human has completed factual and compliance review of that product's copy.
Add a slug only after that review. Blocked slugs are refused even if listed.

5-amino-1mq.acknowledgement: Published with the generator BLOCK knowingly lifted by the project owner on 2026-11-12. The unresolved question is accepted as-is and is NOT considered resolved: "THIN PRECLINICAL LITERATURE AND AN UNRESOLVED COUNTER-ION. A PubMed search for 5-amino-1-methylquinolinium returns THREE indexed records (re-verified 2026-11-11), all preclinical — two mouse studies and one cell-line study — and no human clinical trial. The blocking issue is composition, not the literature: the verified PubChem record is for a CATION (C10H11N2+, 159.21). A cation cannot be supplied alone; it must be paired with a counter-anion whose identity is not stated. Because the counter-anion can be a large fraction of the vial mass, neither the molar content of the 150 mg presentation nor the identity of the supplied salt can be determined from available information." The published copy states this uncertainty rather than asserting an identity or potency claim, coaPurity remains unset so no purity is claimed, and this record is to be revoked if a lot-specific certificate of analysis or an explicit supplier statement later resolves it.

bpc-157-tb-500-blend.acknowledgement: Published with the generator BLOCK knowingly lifted by the project owner on 2026-11-12. The unresolved question is accepted as-is and is NOT considered resolved: "INHERITED IDENTITY AMBIGUITY. This blend contains TB-500, a designation applied in commerce to TWO chemically different substances - full-length thymosin beta-4 (approx 4963 Da) and the fragment Ac-LKKTETQ (approx 889 Da) - differing in mass by roughly 5.6-fold. Which is present is not stated and cannot be determined from supplier information. A blend cannot be better characterised than its least-characterised component, so the ambiguity documented on the TB-500 page propagates here in full. Additionally no per-component quantitation is supplied for the stated 5mg/5mg and 10mg/10mg presentations." The published copy states this uncertainty rather than asserting an identity or potency claim, coaPurity remains unset so no purity is claimed, and this record is to be revoked if a lot-specific certificate of analysis or an explicit supplier statement later resolves it.
